Name: Alexander Baksheev
Subject: TrafficCure and your Emirates Transport stack
Body:
Dear Alexander,

I am reaching out from Lepton Software, India's oldest and largest Google Maps partner. We build TrafficCure, a city-wide road traffic intelligence product built directly on Google's Road Management Insights layer. We are one of only two companies globally on this layer, and Google hosts our live demo on their own RMI website.

I saw that Mappable signed MoUs with Emirates Transport and Fujairah GIS Center at GITEX, so you are actively building out a transport GIS stack right now. The one piece that is hard to build from scratch is the live, network-wide traffic intelligence layer, and that is exactly what TrafficCure delivers, 100 percent city-wide road coverage with no hardware.

Rather than compete with your platform, I think TrafficCure slots in as the data layer underneath it. You own the customer and the stack, we supply the traffic intelligence. We have already proven this model in Abu Dhabi, integrating with existing camera feeds into one unified dashboard.

Would you be open to a short call this week to explore it together?

Warm regards,
Umang Saraf
Director, Lepton Software
